invariants.property: Every normative concept and transition has exactly one canonical domain owner.
No event, prompt, response, tool result or file body is considered observed unless its enabled source emitted it.
Cloud/web/unsupported capability gaps are explicit; lack of telemetry is not proof of inactivity.
Content is classified full, metadata_only, redacted, truncated, placeholder, not_emitted or unknown from evidence.
OTLP traces, metrics and logs decode with standard signal types and reject malformed/unauthorized traffic.
Ingress accepted, durable archive, SQL indexed and complete provider delivery are separate, non-equivalent propositions.
Semantically faithful typed OTLP source envelopes are preserved independently of potentially lossy SQL projections.
Replayed delivery does not double-count one logical observation; ambiguous identities are not silently merged.
Retention target is 365 days, 90-day fallback requires administrative choice, 31-day floor, held records protected.
Local admin/viewer identities and read-only database access protect all sensitive data; no anonymous reporting.
Telemetry payload and prompt/tool content remain data and cannot become executable HTML, SQL, configuration or policy.
Only authentic source-issued correlation keys justify joins; missing or conflicting keys remain visible.
Query/export requires authorized role, bounded filters, safe output encoding and manifest provenance.
Alert rules apply to observable predicates; estimated costs, silence and content gaps cannot imply proven wrongdoing.
Queue pressure, backend failures, disk limits, lost signals and failed restores remain visible and recoverable where possible.
Appliance ships with no license-fee or mandatory paid cloud dependencies.
Independent required flows must each have one complete 10-dimension edge contract; other pairs require typed exclusion.
Every state-event cell has one transition contract or typed exclusion and every declared state is reachable.
No candidate specification, agent, hash or local test can grant BCF governance admission or regulator-grade certification.
Existing BCF Lite governance and unrelated files are preserved unless reviewed supersession explicitly authorizes a change.
Cheap structural checks precede costly integration, execution and evidence qualification; reuse only applicable evidence.

laws.property: Coverage must derive from enabled, version-qualified emitters and source-origin availability indicators.
Decode, authenticate, qualify, accept/buffer, archive and index through separately observed stages.
Typed OTLP archive is source-faithful after decode, not necessarily byte-identical to the received HTTP request.
UI/backend operations use role checks, read-only SQL credentials and safe representation of content.
Pressure creates alerts; it does not silently shorten or delete protected retention.
No output confers investigative certainty beyond its observed basis.
Declare independent required paths; loss of route plus contract does not convert a requirement to exclusion.
Legal transitions require an exact owner operation; impossible states/events are typed exclusions.
Preserve first; then migrate; BCF evaluator governs claim/evidence authority.

source.cost: Payload limits, bounded concurrency/time/retries, no duplicate expensive work
